{"id":1848468720,"question_id":4089,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1765034602,"status":15,"status_display":"Runtime Error","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1848468720/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximize Points After Choosing K Tasks","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    long long maxPoints(vector<int>& technique1, vector<int>& technique2, int k) {\n        vector<int>gain;\n        for(int i=0; i<technique1.size() ; i++){\n            gain.push_back(technique1[i] - technique2[i]);\n        }\n        sort(gain.rbegin() , gain.rend());\n        \n        int totaltech2 = accumulate(technique2 .begin() , technique2.end() , 0);\n        int totaltech1 = accumulate(technique1 .begin() , technique1.end() , 0);\n        int x = 0;\n        for(int i =0; i<k ; i++){\n            totaltech2 += gain[i];\n        }\n\n        for(int i=k ; i<gain.size() ; i++){\n            if(gain[i] > 0) totaltech2 += gain[i];\n        }\n        return totaltech2;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximize-points-after-choosing-k-tasks","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1239}
